response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a highly experienced, versatile full-stack/staff-level engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and open-source projects, but his resume shows no direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, growth engineering, or cross-team measurement systems—the core focus of this Principal/IC6 Growth Experimentation role. His career trajectory is broad and generalist rather than specialized in the domain, and there is no evidence of Principal-level scope leading multi-team, enterprise-scale initiatives tied to growth or data-driven decision systems.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, hands-on engineering experience across multiple languages and platforms (web, mobile, embedded, backend)
Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, workshops, talks, and founding an open-source platform
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development) indicating solid engineering fundamentals
concerns: No evidence of experience with experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, feature flagging, or rollout-risk management
No demonstrated telemetry/metrics infrastructure work or data science collaboration relevant to growth systems
Career titles (Senior/Staff) and project scope don't clearly demonstrate Principal-level (IC6) cross-team architectural leadership at enterprise scale

key_factors.factor: Broad, deep general engineering experience across many languages and systems
Lack of clear Principal-level, multi-team enterprise leadership scope
